question: Which supreme divine presence is to be invoked together with the ruler of all deities?
premises: The ruler of all deities is named
The term pāyai and śrī are included
The supreme mother is named as object
inference: The invocation includes the ruler of all deities and the supreme mother Parāmbikā.
uncertainties: Exact function of pāyai in this context is unclear
plain_english: Invoke the ruler of all deities, pāyai, śrī, and the supreme mother Parāmbikā.
